title: ICAI CA Foundation Comprehensive Syllabus Blueprint
academicBody: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
scheme: New Scheme of Education and Training

subjects.title: Accounting
subjects.description: To develop an understanding of the basic concepts and principles of accounting and acquire the ability to apply the same in preparing financial statements, computing accounting ratios, and solving accounting problems.

chapters.title: Theoretical Framework
chapters.description: Foundational concepts, accounting principles, conventions, terminology, policies, and accounting standards overview.

topics.title: Meaning and Scope of Accounting
learningObjectives: Understand bookkeeping vs accounting vs accountancy
Identify internal and external users of accounting information
Explore sub-fields of accounting (Financial, Cost, Management, Social)
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 1: Meaning and Scope of Accounting

topics.title: Accounting Concepts, Principles and Conventions
learningObjectives: Master Fundamental Accounting Assumptions (Going Concern, Consistency, Accrual)
Understand Business Entity, Money Measurement, Periodicity, Matching, Full Disclosure, Materiality, Prudence/Conservatism, Cost Concept, Realisation Concept
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 2: Accounting Concepts, Principles and Conventions
topics.videoTitle: Accounting Principle & Assumption in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

topics.title: Capital and Revenue Expenditures & Receipts
learningObjectives: Distinguish capital vs revenue expenditures with practical test rules
Analyze deferred revenue expenditures
Classify capital receipts and revenue receipts
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 3: Capital and Revenue Expenditures and Receipts

topics.title: Contingent Assets and Contingent Liabilities
learningObjectives: Differentiate provisions, liabilities, contingent liabilities, and contingent assets
Understand disclosure requirements in notes to accounts
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 4: Contingent Assets and Contingent Liabilities

topics.title: Accounting Policies and Measurement Discipline
learningObjectives: Understand selection and change of accounting policies per AS-1
Grasp Valuation Principles: Historical Cost, Current Cost, Realisable Value, Present Value
Differentiate accounting estimates and policy modifications

topics.title: Accounting Standards & Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS)
learningObjectives: Understand the standard setting process of ICAI and NFRA
Grasp convergence with IFRS and applicability of Ind AS vs AS
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 6: Accounting as a Measurement Discipline

chapters.title: Accounting Process
chapters.description: Double entry book-keeping, Journal, Subsidiary Books, Cash Books, Ledger Posting, Trial Balance, and Rectification of Errors.

topics.title: Journals and Subsidiary Books
learningObjectives: Apply rules of debit and credit (Traditional vs Modern approach)
Draft journal entries and maintain Purchases, Sales, Returns books, Bills books, and Journal Proper
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 1: Basic Accounting Procedures – Journal entries
topics.videoTitle: Basic of 11th with Journal Entry in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

topics.title: Cash Book and Petty Cash Book
learningObjectives: Prepare Simple, Two-column (Cash & Discount), and Three-column (Cash, Bank, Discount) Cash Books
Maintain Imprest Petty Cash Book with analytical columns

topics.title: Ledger Accounts and Trial Balance
learningObjectives: Post journal transactions to ledger and balance ledger accounts
Prepare Trial Balance (Totals Method, Balances Method, Total & Balances Method)
Identify errors disclosed and not disclosed by Trial Balance
topics.videoTitle: Ledger Posting & Trial Balance in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

topics.title: Rectification of Errors
learningObjectives: Classify errors: Omission, Commission, Principle, Compensating
Rectify errors before Trial Balance preparation
Rectify errors after Trial Balance using Suspense Account
Rectify errors in subsequent accounting periods through Profit & Loss Adjustment Account
topics.videoTitle: Rectification Of Error in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy🔥

chapters.title: Bank Reconciliation Statement (BRS)
chapters.description: Causes of divergence between Cash Book and Pass Book / Bank Statement balances, and methods of reconciliation.

topics.title: Causes of Differences & Concept of Overdraft
learningObjectives: Identify timing differences (cheques issued not presented, cheques deposited not cleared)
Identify transactions initiated by bank (interest, bank charges, direct debits/credits)
Handle favorable balances and overdraft (unfavorable) balances
topics.videoTitle: Bank Reconciliation Statement in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

topics.title: Preparation of BRS without Adjusting Cash Book
learningObjectives: Construct BRS starting from Cash Book balance/overdraft to reach Pass Book balance
Construct BRS starting from Pass Book balance/overdraft to reach Cash Book balance
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 3: Bank Reconciliation Statement (Adjusted Cash Book)

topics.title: Preparation of BRS with Adjusted (Amended) Cash Book
learningObjectives: Identify items to be adjusted in the amended cash book prior to reconciliation
Prepare BRS using adjusted cash book balance for correct financial reporting
topics.pdfTitle: Bank Reconciliation Statement (BRS) - Preparation of BRS with Adjusted (Amended) Cash Book

chapters.videoTitle: Bank Reconciliation Statement in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

chapters.title: Inventories
chapters.description: Techniques of inventory valuation, AS-2 compliance, periodic vs perpetual inventory systems, and physical stocktaking reconciliation.

topics.title: Concept of Inventory & AS-2 Valuation Principles
learningObjectives: Understand components of inventory (Raw material, WIP, Finished goods, Stores)
Apply valuation rule: Lower of Cost and Net Realisable Value (NRV)
Calculate Net Realisable Value considering estimated selling expenses
topics.videoTitle: Inventory in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

topics.title: Inventory Costing Methods (FIFO, LIFO, Weighted Average, Retail Method)
learningObjectives: Maintain Stores Ledger Card using First-In-First-Out (FIFO)
Compute cost using Weighted Average Price and Simple Average Price
Apply Adjusted Selling Price (Retail) Method and Standard Cost Method
topics.videoTitle: Calculation Of Normal Loss & Abnormal Loss - 10 Minutes CApsule | CA Foundation | #Accountancy🔥

topics.title: Inventory Systems and Physical Stock Count Adjustments
learningObjectives: Compare Periodic vs Perpetual Inventory Systems
Calculate inventory value when physical stock count is taken before or after the balance sheet date
topics.pdfTitle: Inventories - Inventory Systems and Physical Stock Count Adjustments

chapters.videoTitle: Inventory in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

chapters.title: Depreciation and Amortisation
chapters.description: Depreciation of Property, Plant & Equipment (AS-10), calculation methods, change in methods, change in useful life, and asset disposal.

topics.title: Depreciation Concepts & Cost of PPE per AS-10
learningObjectives: Understand causes and factors affecting depreciation
Determine total cost of PPE (Purchase price, directly attributable costs, dismantling)
Differentiate depreciation, amortisation, and depletion
topics.videoTitle: Depreciation in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

topics.title: Methods of Calculating Depreciation
learningObjectives: Straight Line Method (SLM) / Fixed Installment
Written Down Value Method (WDV) / Reducing Balance
Sum of Years' Digits Method, Machine Hour Rate, Production Units Method

topics.title: Accounting Treatment, Asset Disposal & Revaluation
learningObjectives: Account for Provision for Depreciation Account
Prepare Asset Disposal Account on sale or retirement of asset
Handle prospective accounting for change in method and change in useful life/residual value
topics.pdfTitle: Depreciation and Amortisation - Accounting Treatment, Asset Disposal & Revaluation

chapters.videoTitle: Depreciation in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

chapters.title: Bills of Exchange and Promissory Notes
chapters.description: Negotiable instruments in accounting, discounting, endorsement, dishonour, noting charges, renewal, insolvency, and accommodation bills.

topics.title: Nature and Terminology of Bills of Exchange
learningObjectives: Parties to Bills of Exchange and Promissory Notes (Drawer, Drawee, Payee)
Calculate days of grace and due dates for bills payable at sight vs after date/sight
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 6: Bills of Exchange & Promissory Notes
topics.videoTitle: Bill Of Exchange in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

topics.title: Standard Accounting Entries & Dishonour with Noting Charges
learningObjectives: Record retention till maturity, discounting with bank, and endorsement to creditor
Handle dishonour of bills and recording of noting charges
Bill sent for collection entries

topics.title: Renewal of Bills, Insolvency, and Accommodation Bills
learningObjectives: Record renewal of bills with interest computation
Account for insolvency of drawee and bad debts recovery
Pass entries for accommodation bills and apportionment of proceeds
topics.pdfTitle: Bills of Exchange and Promissory Notes - Renewal of Bills, Insolvency, and Accommodation Bills

chapters.pdfTitle: Ch 6: Bills of Exchange and Promissory Notes
chapters.videoTitle: Bill Of Exchange in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

chapters.title: Preparation of Final Accounts of Sole Proprietors
chapters.description: Preparation of Manufacturing Account, Trading Account, Profit and Loss Account, and Balance Sheet with comprehensive year-end adjustments.

topics.title: Manufacturing Account & Cost of Production
learningObjectives: Identify Raw Material Consumed, Direct Wages, Direct Expenses, Factory Overheads
Adjust Opening and Closing WIP to compute Cost of Finished Goods Produced
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 1: Final Accounts of Non-Manufacturing Entities
topics.videoTitle: Final Account - Manufacturing in One Shot (Part - 02) | CA Foundation | Accountancy🔥

topics.title: Trading and Profit & Loss Account
learningObjectives: Calculate Gross Profit / Loss and Net Profit / Loss
Distinguish operating income/expenses and non-operating income/expenses
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 2: Final Accounts of Manufacturing Entities
topics.videoTitle: Final Account (Mfg & Non-Mfg) in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy🔥

topics.title: Balance Sheet & Year-End Adjustments
learningObjectives: Group and marshal assets and liabilities (Order of Liquidity vs Permanence)

Handle complex adjustments: Bad Debts & Provision for Doubtful/Discount on Debtors, Manager's Commission (Before/After charging), Goods in transit, Goods sent on approval basis, Abnormal loss of stock
topics.pdfTitle: Preparation of Final Accounts of Sole Proprietors - Balance Sheet & Year-End Adjustments
topics.videoTitle: Final Accounts With Adjustment - 25 Minutes CApsule | CA Foundation | #Accountancy🔥

chapters.pdfTitle: Ch 7: Preparation of Final Accounts of Sole Proprietors
chapters.videoTitle: Final Account (Mfg & Non-Mfg) in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy🔥

chapters.title: Financial Statements of Not-for-Profit Organisations (NPO)
chapters.description: Receipts and Payments Account, Income and Expenditure Account, Capital Fund, Subscription Ledger, and Balance Sheet.

topics.title: NPO Concept & Receipts and Payments Account
learningObjectives: Features of NPO, Capital vs Revenue items in NPO
Preparation and characteristics of Receipts and Payments Account (Cash basis)
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 8: Not-for-Profit Organisations (Receipts & Payments, Income & Expenditure)
topics.videoTitle: NPO in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy🔥

topics.title: Income and Expenditure Account & Subscription Accounting
learningObjectives: Construct Income & Expenditure Account (Accrual basis) showing Surplus/Deficit
Master Subscription Account computation (Outstanding, Advance, Arrears)
Handle Consumable Items (Medicines, Sports material, Stationery) and Fund-based Accounting
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 8: NPO Balance Sheet & Special Funds

topics.title: Opening & Closing Balance Sheet of NPO
learningObjectives: Ascertain opening Capital Fund from Opening Balance Sheet
Prepare comprehensive Closing Balance Sheet with specific funds, endowments, and legacies
topics.pdfTitle: Financial Statements of Not-for-Profit Organisations (NPO) - Opening & Closing Balance Sheet of NPO

chapters.pdfTitle: Ch 8: Financial Statements of Not-for-Profit Organisations
chapters.videoTitle: NPO in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy🔥

chapters.title: Accounts from Incomplete Records (Single Entry System)
chapters.description: Determination of profit or loss under single entry system via Statement of Affairs and Conversion method to double entry.

topics.title: Statement of Affairs Method
learningObjectives: Ascertain opening and closing capital using Statement of Affairs
Calculate net profit/loss adjusting for drawings, additional capital, and depreciation
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 9: Single Entry System & Statement of Affairs

topics.title: Conversion Method to Double Entry
learningObjectives: Reconstruct Total Debtors and Total Creditors Accounts to find credit sales/purchases
Prepare Bills Receivable / Payable Accounts and Cash / Bank summary
Draft Final Accounts from incomplete transactional records
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 9: Incomplete Records to Double Entry Conversion

chapters.title: Partnership and LLP Accounts
chapters.description: Fundamentals, P&L Appropriation, Goodwill valuation, Admission, Retirement, Death, and Dissolution of Partnership Firms.

topics.title: Partnership Fundamentals, P&L Appropriation & Capital Accounts
learningObjectives: Fixed vs Fluctuating Capital Accounts
Calculate Interest on Capital, Interest on Drawings (Average Period method, Product method)
Solve Past Adjustments and Guarantee of Minimum Profits
topics.videoTitle: Partnership Accounts in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

topics.title: Goodwill Valuation and Accounting Treatment
learningObjectives: Compute Goodwill: Average Profit, Super Profit, Capitalisation Methods
Account for Goodwill on change in PSR without raising Goodwill account (Sacrificing/Gaining ratio)
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 2: Treatment of Goodwill in Partnership Accounts

topics.title: Admission of a Partner
learningObjectives: Calculate New Profit Sharing Ratio and Sacrificing Ratio
Prepare Revaluation Account and Memorandum Revaluation Account
Adjust accumulated reserves, hidden goodwill, and adjust partners' capitals
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 3: Admission of a New Partner

topics.title: Retirement and Death of a Partner
learningObjectives: Calculate Gaining Ratio and treatment of goodwill on retirement/death
Account for Joint Life Policy (JLP) and Individual Life Policies
Prepare Retiring Partner's Loan Account and Deceased Partner's Executor Account with interim profit share (Sec 37)

topics.title: Dissolution of Partnership Firm & Piecemeal Distribution
learningObjectives: Prepare Realisation Account, Partner's Loan Account, and Bank/Cash Account
Apply settlement rules under Section 48 of the Indian Partnership Act
Calculate Piecemeal Distribution using Proportionate Capital Method and Maximum Loss Method

chapters.videoTitle: Partnership Accounts in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

chapters.title: Company Accounts
chapters.description: Issue of Shares and Debentures, Forfeiture, Re-issue, Redemption of Preference Shares, Redemption of Debentures, and Company Balance Sheet overview.

topics.title: Issue, Forfeiture, and Re-issue of Shares
learningObjectives: Account for Issue at Par, Premium, Calls in Arrears, Calls in Advance with Interest
Master Pro-rata Allotment with excess application money adjustment
Record Forfeiture of shares and Re-issue at Discount, transferring profit to Capital Reserve
topics.videoTitle: Share Capital in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy🔥

topics.title: Redemption of Preference Shares
learningObjectives: Apply legal provisions of Section 55 of Companies Act, 2013
Creation of Capital Redemption Reserve (CRR) out of divisible profits
Issue of fresh equity shares for redemption purposes
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 2: Issue, Forfeiture and Re-Issue of Shares

topics.title: Issue and Redemption of Debentures
learningObjectives: Account for issue of debentures with redemption terms (Par, Premium, Discount)
Issue of debentures as Collateral Security
Methods of redemption and writing off Loss on Issue of Debentures
topics.videoTitle: Debenture in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

topics.title: Company Financial Statements (Schedule III Overview)
learningObjectives: Format of Balance Sheet and Statement of Profit and Loss per Schedule III (Division I)
Presentation of Share Capital and Reserves & Surplus in Notes to Accounts
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 4: Accounting for Bonus Issue and Right Issue

chapters.title: Special Transactions (Reference Modules)
chapters.description: Special accounting transactions including Consignment Accounts, Average Due Date, and Account Current.

topics.title: Consignment Accounts
learningObjectives: Understand consignment transactions vs normal sales
Accounting entries in consignor and consignee books
Valuation of unsold consignment stock and commission calculations
topics.videoTitle: Consignment in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

topics.title: Average Due Date
learningObjectives: Concept of average due date and base date determination
Calculation of interest in trade accounts and loans
topics.videoTitle: Average Due Date in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy 🔥

topics.title: Account Current
learningObjectives: Preparation of Account Current using Interest Tables, Means Product, and Red-ink interest
topics.videoTitle: Account Current in One Shot | CA Foundation | Accountancy

subjects.title: Business Laws
subjects.description: To develop general legal awareness, understand fundamental principles of mercantile and corporate laws, and acquire skills to analyze legal problems and formulate logical legal solutions.

chapters.title: Indian Regulatory Framework
chapters.description: Introduction to the Indian legal system, sources of law, legislative process, hierarchy of courts, and major regulatory authorities (RBI, SEBI, MCA, IRDAI, CCI, IBBI).

topics.title: Structure of the Indian Legal System & Sources of Law
learningObjectives: Understand Primary & Secondary sources of law (Constitution, Statutes, Case Law, Customs)
Trace the legislative law-making process in Parliament (Bill to Act)
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 1: Indian Legal System & Sources of Law

topics.title: Hierarchy of Courts and Key Regulatory Bodies
learningObjectives: Hierarchy of Civil and Criminal Courts (Supreme Court, High Courts, District Courts, Tribunals)
Roles of MCA, SEBI, RBI, IRDAI, CCI, and IBBI in Indian commercial regulation

chapters.title: The Indian Contract Act, 1872
chapters.description: General principles of contract law including formation, consideration, capacity, free consent, performance, breach and remedies, plus special contracts (Indemnity, Guarantee, Bailment, Pledge, Agency).

topics.title: Nature and Classification of Contracts
learningObjectives: Define Contract (Sec 2(h)) and Agreement (Sec 2(e))
Analyze Essential Elements of a Valid Contract (Sec 10)
Classify contracts by Validity, Formation, and Performance

topics.title: Offer and Acceptance
learningObjectives: Rules for a valid Proposal/Offer vs Invitation to Offer
Legal rules regarding valid Acceptance
Communication and Revocation of Offer and Acceptance (Postal rule - Sec 4 & 5)

topics.title: Consideration & Doctrine of Privity
learningObjectives: Define Consideration (Sec 2(d)) and legal rules for valid consideration
Doctrine of Privity of Contract and its exceptions (Dunlop v Selfridge)
Exceptions to 'No Consideration, No Contract' (Sec 25)
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 3: Other Essential Elements of a Contract

topics.title: Capacity to Contract
learningObjectives: Position of Minor: Mohori Bibee case, agreements void ab initio, rule of estoppel, necessaries
Persons of Unsound Mind and Disqualified Persons (Alien enemy, convicts, insolvents)

topics.title: Free Consent & Factors Vitiating Consent
learningObjectives: Coercion (Sec 15) vs Undue Influence (Sec 16 - Burden of proof, fiduciary relationships)
Fraud (Sec 17 - Silence as fraud) vs Misrepresentation (Sec 18)
Mistake of Fact vs Mistake of Law (Bilateral vs Unilateral mistake)
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 5: Breach of Contract and its Remedies

topics.title: Legality of Object, Void Agreements & Contingent Contracts
learningObjectives: Agreements opposed to public policy and unlawful considerations
Wagering Agreements (Sec 30) vs Insurance contracts
Contingent Contracts (Sec 31-36) and Quasi Contracts (Sec 68-72)

topics.title: Performance and Discharge of Contracts
learningObjectives: Performance by Promisor/Agent, Time and Place of performance, Joint promisors
Appropriation of Payments (Clayton's Case - Sec 59-61)
Modes of Discharge: Performance, Novation, Rescission, Frustration/Supervening Impossibility
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 7: Contract of Indemnity and Guarantee

topics.title: Breach of Contract and its Remedies
learningObjectives: Actual vs Anticipatory Breach and options available to aggrieved party
Types of Damages: Ordinary (Hadley v Baxendale), Special, Vindictive, Nominal, Pre-fixed
Remedies: Rescission, Suit for Damages, Specific Performance, Injunction, Quantum Meruit

topics.title: Special Contracts: Indemnity, Guarantee, Bailment, Pledge & Agency
learningObjectives: Contract of Indemnity (Sec 124) vs Contract of Guarantee (Sec 126), Rights & Discharge of Surety
Bailment & Pledge: Rights, duties, finder of goods, pledge by non-owners
Contract of Agency: Creation, types of agents, rights/duties, principal's liability, termination

chapters.title: The Sale of Goods Act, 1930
chapters.description: Formation of contract of sale, conditions and warranties, transfer of property/ownership, performance of contract, and unpaid seller's rights.

topics.title: Formation of the Contract of Sale
learningObjectives: Define Contract of Sale, Sale vs Agreement to Sell, Sale vs Hire Purchase vs Bailment
Types of Goods: Existing (Specific, Ascertained, Unascertained), Future, Contingent
Effect of perishing of goods (Sec 7 & 8) and ascertainment of price
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 1: Formation of the Contract of Sale

topics.title: Conditions and Warranties
learningObjectives: Distinction between Condition and Warranty (Stipulation vital vs collateral)
When condition is treated as warranty (Sec 13)
Express and Implied Conditions & Warranties
Doctrine of Caveat Emptor and its statutory exceptions

topics.title: Transfer of Ownership and Delivery of Goods
learningObjectives: Passing of property in specific goods in deliverable / non-deliverable state
Passing of property in unascertained goods and goods sent on approval
Risk follows ownership principle and its exceptions
Sale by Non-Owners (Nemo Dat Quod Non Habet) and all statutory exceptions (Sec 27-30)
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 3: Transfer of Ownership and Delivery of Goods

topics.title: Unpaid Seller and Rights against Goods & Buyer
learningObjectives: Definition of Unpaid Seller (Sec 45)
Rights against goods: Right of Lien, Right of Stoppage in Transit, Right of Resale
Rights against buyer personally: Suit for price, damages for non-acceptance, interest
Auction Sale rules (Sec 64)

chapters.pdfTitle: Ch 3: The Sale of Goods Act, 1930

chapters.title: The Indian Partnership Act, 1932
chapters.description: Nature of partnership, relation of partners to one another and third parties, incoming and outgoing partners, registration, and dissolution.

topics.title: General Nature of Partnership
learningObjectives: Definition of Partnership (Sec 4) and 5 essential elements
True test of Partnership: Sharing of profits vs Mutual Agency (Cox v Hickman)
Types of Partners (Active, Sleeping, Nominal, Sub-partner, Partner by Estoppel/Holding Out)
Types of Partnerships (Partnership at Will, Particular Partnership)

topics.title: Relations of Partners to One Another & Third Parties
learningObjectives: Mutual rights and duties of partners, determination of partnership property
Implied Authority of a Partner: Scope, statutory restrictions (Sec 19(2)), emergency powers
Liability of firm for wrongful acts of partner and misapplication of money
Minor admitted to benefits of partnership (Sec 30) - Rights, liabilities, election upon attaining majority

topics.title: Reconstitution, Registration & Dissolution of Firm
learningObjectives: Incoming, outgoing partners, expulsion, retirement, insolvency, and death of a partner
Procedure and consequences of non-registration of a firm (Sec 69) and exceptions
Dissolution of Partnership vs Dissolution of Firm
Modes of dissolution (Agreement, Compulsory, Contingent, Notice, Court Order) and Sec 48 settlement
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 3: Registration and Dissolution of a Firm

chapters.title: The Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008
chapters.description: Salient features of LLP, designated partners, incorporation procedure, LLP agreement, relationship of partners, and conversion/winding up.

topics.title: Salient Features & Designated Partners
learningObjectives: Meaning, concept, and key characteristics of LLP (Body corporate, perpetual succession, mutual agency absent between partners)
Designated Partners (DPIN requirement, minimum 2 individuals with at least 1 resident in India)
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 5: Salient Features & Designated Partners of LLP

topics.title: Incorporation of LLP & LLP Agreement
learningObjectives: Steps in incorporation: RUN-LLP, FiLLiP, Certificate of Incorporation
LLP Agreement (Form 3) and default provisions under First Schedule in absence of agreement
Registered office, change of name, and partner registration
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 5: Incorporation of LLP & LLP Agreement

topics.title: Differences, Conversion, and Winding Up of LLP
learningObjectives: Detailed comparative analysis: LLP vs Traditional Partnership vs Private Limited Company
Conversion of firm/private company into LLP
Winding up of LLP (Voluntary vs By Tribunal under Sec 64)
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 5: Conversion, Differences & Winding Up of LLP

chapters.pdfTitle: Ch 5: The Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008

chapters.title: The Companies Act, 2013
chapters.description: Company characteristics, lifting of corporate veil, classes of companies, incorporation process, MOA & AOA, and corporate doctrines.

topics.title: Company Characteristics & Lifting of Corporate Veil
learningObjectives: Definition (Sec 2(20)) and characteristics (Separate Legal Entity - Salomon v Salomon, Limited Liability, Common Seal)
Doctrine of Lifting / Piercing the Corporate Veil (Judicial interpretations: protection of revenue, fraud avoidance, enemy character)

topics.title: Classification and Types of Companies
learningObjectives: Private Company (Sec 2(68)), Public Company (Sec 2(71)), One Person Company (OPC - Sec 2(62))
Small Company (Sec 2(85)), Holding & Subsidiary Company (Sec 2(46)/Sec 2(87)), Associate Company
Section 8 (Non-profit) Companies: Formation, privileges, revocation of license
Government Companies, Listed/Unlisted, Foreign Companies, Dormant Companies
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 6: Classification and Types of Companies

topics.title: Incorporation of Company & SPICe+ Process
learningObjectives: Incorporation procedure under SPICe+ (Part A: Name Reservation, Part B: Incorporation, PAN, TAN, DIN, EPFO, ESIC, Bank A/c)
Certificate of Incorporation, CIN, Commencement of Business (Sec 10A)

topics.title: Memorandum of Association (MOA) & Articles of Association (AOA)
learningObjectives: Clauses of MOA (Name, Registered Office, Object, Liability, Capital, Association/Subscription)
Articles of Association contents and entrenchment provisions
Doctrine of Ultra Vires (Ashbury Railway Carriage case) and effects
Doctrine of Constructive Notice vs Doctrine of Indoor Management (Turquand Rule) and exceptions

topics.title: Share Capital Basics & Debentures
learningObjectives: Authorized, Issued, Subscribed, Called-up, Paid-up capital
Equity shares (with voting rights / differential voting rights) and Preference shares
Debentures and statutory restrictions

chapters.title: The Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881
chapters.description: Meaning and essential characteristics of Promissory Notes, Bills of Exchange, and Cheques; Holder and Holder in Due Course; Negotiation; Dishonour and Sec 138 penalties.

topics.title: Instruments: Promissory Notes, Bills of Exchange & Cheques
learningObjectives: Definition and essential characteristics of Promissory Note (Sec 4), Bill of Exchange (Sec 5), Cheque (Sec 6)
Distinction between Promissory Note, Bill of Exchange, and Cheque
Electronic Cheque and Truncated Cheque definitions
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 7: Promissory Notes, Bills of Exchange & Cheques

topics.title: Holder, Holder in Due Course (HDC) & Negotiation
learningObjectives: Define Holder (Sec 8) vs Holder in Due Course (Sec 9)
Privileges of Holder in Due Course (Inchoate stamped instruments, fictitious payee, prior defects cleansed)
Modes of Negotiation: By Delivery and By Endorsement (Blank, Special, Restrictive, Conditional, Sans Recourse)
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 7: Holder, Holder in Due Course (HDC) & Negotiation

topics.title: Crossing of Cheques & Material Alteration
learningObjectives: Types of Crossing: General Crossing, Special Crossing, Account Payee Crossing, Not Negotiable Crossing
Protection to Paying Banker and Collecting Banker (Sec 85, 128, 131)
Material Alteration (Sec 87) and alterations allowed by law
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 7: Crossing of Cheques & Material Alteration

topics.title: Dishonour of Cheques & Penalties under Section 138-142
learningObjectives: Dishonour by Non-acceptance and Non-payment, Notice of Dishonour, Noting and Protest
Offence under Section 138: Dishonour for insufficiency of funds
Ingredients and strict statutory timelines: Notice within 30 days, payment within 15 days, complaint within 1 month
Offences by companies (Sec 141) and Interim Compensation (Sec 143A & 148)

subjects.title: Quantitative Aptitude
subjects.description: To test the ability of students to understand mathematical, logical, and statistical tools and apply them in business, finance, and accounting problems.

chapters.title: Ratio, Proportion, Indices, and Logarithms
chapters.description: Foundational algebra: Ratios, compound/duplicate ratios, laws of indices, logarithms laws, characteristic and mantissa.

topics.title: Ratio and Proportion
learningObjectives: Properties of ratios, inverse ratio, compound ratio, duplicate, sub-duplicate, triplicate, sub-triplicate ratio
Direct, inverse, and continued proportion, componendo and dividendo rules

topics.title: Laws of Indices
learningObjectives: Basic exponential rules: product law, quotient law, power of power
Fractional exponents, zero exponent, and negative powers simplification

topics.title: Logarithms
learningObjectives: Fundamental laws of logarithms: Product, Quotient, Power rules
Base change theorem, Common Logarithms, Characteristic and Mantissa calculation

chapters.pdfTitle: Ch 1: Ratio and Proportion, Indices, Logarithms

chapters.title: Equations
chapters.description: Linear equations in 1, 2, and 3 variables, quadratic equations, nature of roots, and symmetric expressions of roots.

topics.title: Linear Equations (1, 2, and 3 Variables)
learningObjectives: Solve simultaneous linear equations using substitution, elimination, and matrix/cross-multiplication methods
Word problems involving speed, distance, age, and cost

topics.title: Quadratic and Cubic Equations
learningObjectives: Solve quadratic equations using factoring and quadratic formula
Examine nature of roots using Discriminant (D = b^2 - 4ac)
Calculate sum (alpha + beta) and product (alpha * beta) of roots and construct equations
Solve symmetric expressions of roots and factor simple cubic polynomials

chapters.title: Linear Inequalities
chapters.description: Linear inequalities in one and two variables, graphical representation, and finding the common feasible region.

Compute Compound Interest across varying compounding periods (annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly, continuous)

Amortization table and loan installment computation

Net Present Value (NPV) criteria for capital budgeting

chapters.title: Permutations and Combinations
chapters.description: Fundamental principles of counting, factorial, permutations (linear, circular, restricted), combinations, division into groups, and combinatorial problem solving.

topics.title: Principles of Counting & Permutations
learningObjectives: Fundamental principles of multiplication and addition
Linear permutations: nPr = n! / (n - r)!
Permutations with repeated items: n! / (p! q! r!)
Circular permutations: (n - 1)! for persons, (n - 1)! / 2 for necklaces/garlands
Restricted permutations (items together vs never together)

topics.title: Combinations and Grouping
learningObjectives: Combinations formula: nCr = n! / (r! (n - r)!)
Combinatorial identities: nCr = nC(n-r), nCr + nC(r-1) = (n+1)Cr
Division of items into equal and unequal groups
Geometry problems (number of lines, triangles, diagonals of polygon = n(n-3)/2)

chapters.pdfTitle: Ch 5: Basic Concepts of Permutations and Combinations

chapters.title: Sequence and Series (AP and GP)
chapters.description: Arithmetic Progression (AP), Geometric Progression (GP), nth term, sum of n terms, arithmetic & geometric means, and special series.

topics.title: Arithmetic Progression (AP)
learningObjectives: Identify common difference 'd', nth term: Tn = a + (n - 1)d
Sum of n terms: Sn = n/2 * [2a + (n - 1)d] = n/2 * (a + l)
Arithmetic Mean (AM) insertion between numbers

topics.title: Geometric Progression (GP) & Special Series
learningObjectives: Identify common ratio 'r', nth term: Tn = a * r^(n-1)
Sum of n terms of GP: Sn = a(r^n - 1) / (r - 1)
Sum of infinite GP: S_inf = a / (1 - r) for |r| < 1
Geometric Mean (GM) and sum of first n natural numbers (Sigma n, Sigma n^2, Sigma n^3)

chapters.pdfTitle: Ch 6: Sequence and Series - AP and GP

chapters.title: Sets, Relations, and Functions
chapters.description: Set theory, Venn diagrams, Cartesian products, Relations (reflexive, symmetric, transitive, equivalence), and Functions (domain, co-domain, range, composite, inverse).

topics.title: Sets and Venn Diagrams
learningObjectives: Representation of sets (Roster vs Set-builder), Types of sets (Null, Universal, Finite, Infinite, Power set 2^n)
Set operations: Union, Intersection, Difference, Complement, De Morgan's Laws
Practical word problems using 2-set and 3-set Venn diagrams

topics.title: Relations and Functions
learningObjectives: Cartesian product of sets, Domain and Range of relation
Types of relations: Reflexive, Symmetric, Transitive, Equivalence relation
Types of functions: One-to-One (Injective), Onto (Surjective), Bijective
Composite functions (fog, gof) and Inverse functions f^(-1)

chapters.title: Basic Applications of Differential and Integral Calculus

topics.title: Differential Calculus & Business Applications
learningObjectives: Derivatives of standard functions: x^n, e^x, a^x, ln(x)
Rules of differentiation: Sum, Difference, Product (uv), Quotient (u/v), Chain Rule
Marginal Cost (MC = dTC/dQ), Marginal Revenue (MR = dTR/dQ), Elasticity
Maxima and Minima of single variable functions (First and Second derivative tests)

topics.title: Integral Calculus & Consumer/Producer Surplus
learningObjectives: Indefinite integrals of standard algebraic, exponential, and fractional functions
Definite integrals and fundamental theorem of calculus
Finding Total Cost from Marginal Cost and Total Revenue from Marginal Revenue
Calculate Consumer Surplus and Producer Surplus using definite integrals

chapters.pdfTitle: Ch 8: Basic Applications of Differential and Integral Calculus

learningObjectives: Identify patterns: Arithmetic differences, geometric multiples, square/cube offsets, Fibonacci sequence
Alpha-numeric and alternating positional patterns

learningObjectives: Letter coding (shifting positions), number coding, substitution ciphering
Odd Man Out classification based on mathematical and logical properties

learningObjectives: Master 8 directions: North, South, East, West, NE, NW, SE, SW
Track left/right turns, clockwise/anticlockwise angles (45 deg, 90 deg, 135 deg, 180 deg)
Calculate displacement and shortest path using Pythagoras Theorem
Solve shadow problems at sunrise and sunset

chapters.title: Seating Arrangements
chapters.description: Linear arrangements (single row, double row, north/south facing), circular arrangements (facing center, facing outward), and complex seating constraints.

topics.title: Linear and Circular Seating Arrangements
learningObjectives: Linear arrangements: Single row facing North or South, parallel rows facing each other
Circular arrangements: Persons facing center (Left = Clockwise, Right = Anticlockwise) vs facing outward
Step-by-step constraint mapping and positional deduction
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 11: Linear and Circular Seating Arrangements

chapters.title: Blood Relations
chapters.description: Family relationships, genealogical family tree diagrams, conversation-based relation puzzles, and coded blood relation questions.

topics.title: Blood Relations & Coded Puzzles
learningObjectives: Identify maternal vs paternal relations, generations, and in-law relations
Construct structured Family Tree diagrams with standard gender (+/-) and marriage (=) notation
Decode pointing-to-a-person statements and solve coded relations (A + B means A is father of B)

topics.title: Collection and Classification of Data
learningObjectives: Primary vs Secondary data, methods of data collection
Classification: Chronological, Geographical, Qualitative (Ordinal), Quantitative (Discrete/Continuous)
Frequency distributions: Class limits, Class boundaries, Class mark/mid-point, Class width, Cumulative frequency
topics.pdfTitle: Unit I: Statistical Description of Data

topics.title: Diagrammatic and Graphical Representation
learningObjectives: Parts of a formal statistical table (Stub, Caption, Body, Title, Source)
Bar diagrams (Simple, Multiple, Subdivided, Percentage) and Pie Chart angle computation
Histogram (equal vs unequal class intervals - frequency density), Frequency Polygon, and Less-than/More-than Ogives (graphical determination of Median)

chapters.pdfTitle: Ch 13: Statistical Description of Data & Sampling

chapters.title: Measures of Central Tendency and Dispersion
chapters.description: Mean, Median, Mode, GM, HM, Quartiles, Deciles, Percentiles, Range, Mean Deviation, Standard Deviation, Variance, Coefficient of Variation, and change of origin/scale properties.

topics.title: Measures of Central Tendency (Mean, Median, Mode, GM, HM)
learningObjectives: Arithmetic Mean: Simple, Weighted, Combined Mean formula
Median, Quartiles (Q1, Q3), Deciles, Percentiles for grouped and ungrouped data
Mode formula for grouped data and Empirical relation: Mode = 3*Median - 2*Mean
Geometric Mean (GM) and Harmonic Mean (HM) properties: AM >= GM >= HM
Master effect of change of origin and scale on central tendency measures
topics.pdfTitle: Unit I: Measures of Central Tendency (Mean, Median, Mode)

topics.title: Measures of Dispersion (SD, Variance, MD, QD & CV)
learningObjectives: Range and Coefficient of Range
Mean Deviation from Mean and Median, and Coefficient of MD
Standard Deviation (SD / sigma), Variance, Combined Standard Deviation
Quartile Deviation (QD = (Q3 - Q1)/2) and Coefficient of QD
Coefficient of Variation (CV = (SD / Mean) * 100) to compare consistency
Master effect of change of origin (no effect) and scale (affected by absolute scale factor) on dispersion
topics.pdfTitle: Unit II: Measures of Dispersion (SD, Variance, MD, QD, CV)

chapters.pdfTitle: Ch 14: Measures of Central Tendency and Dispersion

chapters.title: Probability
chapters.description: Classical, empirical, and axiomatic probability, sample space, independent events, conditional probability, addition and multiplication theorems, and Bayes' Theorem.

topics.title: Basic Probability & Theorems of Probability
learningObjectives: Sample space, Mutually exclusive, Exhaustive, Independent, and Equally likely events
Odds in favour: a / b, Odds against: b / a
Addition Theorem: P(A U B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A n B)
Multiplication Theorem for independent events: P(A n B) = P(A) * P(B)

topics.title: Conditional Probability, Mathematical Expectation & Bayes' Theorem
learningObjectives: Conditional Probability: P(A|B) = P(A n B) / P(B)
Mathematical Expectation: E(X) = Sigma [x * P(x)], Variance V(X) = E(X^2) - [E(X)]^2
Bayes' Theorem for posterior probability estimation given prior evidence

chapters.title: Theoretical Distributions
chapters.description: Binomial Distribution, Poisson Distribution, and Normal Distribution with all properties, parameters, and applications.

topics.title: Binomial Distribution
learningObjectives: PMF: P(X = r) = nCr * p^r * q^(n-r), where p + q = 1
Parameters n and p; Mean = np, Variance = npq (Mean > Variance)
Uni-modal and bi-modal conditions, additive property

topics.title: Poisson Distribution
learningObjectives: PMF: P(X = r) = (e^(-m) * m^r) / r!, for rare events where n -> inf, p -> 0
Single parameter m / lambda; Mean = Variance = m
Additive property of independent Poisson variates

topics.title: Normal (Gaussian) Distribution
learningObjectives: Bell-shaped symmetrical curve around Mean = Median = Mode = mu
Total area under curve = 1; Standard Normal Variate z = (X - mu) / sigma
Key empirical ratios: QD ~ (2/3) sigma, MD ~ (4/5) sigma
Standard areas: mu +/- 1 sigma (68.27%), mu +/- 2 sigma (95.45%), mu +/- 3 sigma (99.73%)

chapters.title: Correlation and Regression
chapters.description: Scatter diagram, Karl Pearson's r, Spearman's rank correlation, concurrent deviations, regression lines, regression coefficients (byx, bxy), and angle between regression lines.

topics.title: Correlation Analysis (Karl Pearson, Spearman Rank, Concurrent Deviation)
learningObjectives: Types of correlation: Positive, Negative, Zero, Linear, Non-linear
Karl Pearson's coefficient of correlation r (-1 <= r <= 1), formula: Cov(X,Y) / (sigma_x * sigma_y)
Properties of r: Independent of change of origin and scale (sign depends on signs of scale changes)
Spearman's Rank Correlation: R = 1 - [6 * Sigma d^2] / [n(n^2 - 1)] (with tied rank correction)
Coefficient of Concurrent Deviations: r_c = +/- sqrt[ +/- (2c - m) / m ]

topics.title: Regression Analysis & Properties
learningObjectives: Regression equation of Y on X: (Y - Y_bar) = byx * (X - X_bar), where byx = r * (sigma_y / sigma_x)
Regression equation of X on Y: (X - X_bar) = bxy * (Y - Y_bar), where bxy = r * (sigma_x / sigma_y)
Properties of regression coefficients: r = +/- sqrt(byx * bxy); both must have same sign
If one coefficient > 1, the other must be < 1; AM of byx and bxy >= r
Regression lines intersect at Mean Point (X_bar, Y_bar)

chapters.title: Index Numbers
chapters.description: Price and quantity index numbers, Laspeyres, Paasche, Fisher's ideal, Marshall-Edgeworth, tests of adequacy (Time Reversal, Factor Reversal, Circular), base shifting, splicing, deflating, and CPI.

topics.title: Index Number Formulas & Weighted Aggregative Methods
learningObjectives: Simple aggregative method and Simple average of price relatives

Weighted aggregative methods: Laspeyres (Base weights P01^L = [Sigma p1 q0 / Sigma p0 q0] * 100), Paasche (Current weights P01^P), Fisher's Ideal (Geometric mean of L and P), Marshall-Edgeworth, Bowley-Dorbisch
Consumer Price Index (CPI) / Cost of Living Index: Aggregate Expenditure & Family Budget methods
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 18: Index Number Formulas & Weighted Aggregates

topics.title: Tests of Adequacy, Shifting, Splicing & Deflating
learningObjectives: Tests of Adequacy: Time Reversal Test (P01 * P10 = 1 - satisfied by Fisher, Marshall-Edgeworth), Factor Reversal Test (P01 * Q01 = V01 - satisfied only by Fisher's Ideal), Circular Test
Base shifting, Splicing overlapping series, and Deflating index numbers (Real Wage = Money Wage / CPI * 100)
topics.pdfTitle: Ch 18: Tests of Adequacy, Splicing & Deflating

Budget Line / Price Line and Consumer Equilibrium (MRSxy = Px / Py)

learningObjectives: Factors of Production (Land, Labour, Capital, Entrepreneur) and Cobb-Douglas Production Function
Law of Variable Proportions: Total Product (TP), Average Product (AP), Marginal Product (MP) relationships and 3 Stages (Stage of rational production)

learningObjectives: TR, AR, MR definitions and relationships
Formula relating AR, MR and Price Elasticity: MR = AR * (1 - 1/e)
Classification of markets by degree of competition, geographic area, time, and regulation
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 1: Meaning and Types of Markets

topics.title: Perfect Competition Equilibrium
learningObjectives: Characteristics of Perfect Competition (Price taker firm, horizontal demand curve P = AR = MR)
Short-run equilibrium conditions (MR = MC, MC cuts MR from below; Supernormal profit, Normal profit, Subnormal loss, Shutdown point P < AVC)
Long-run equilibrium of firm and industry: P = AR = MR = LMC = LAC (Zero economic profit)

topics.title: Monopoly & Price Discrimination
learningObjectives: Features of Monopoly (Single seller, barriers to entry, downward sloping AR and MR curves)
Short-run and long-run equilibrium of Monopolist
Price Discrimination: First degree (perfect), Second degree, Third degree (Pigou); Conditions necessary for profitable price discrimination

Paul Sweezy's Kinked Demand Curve Model (Price rigidity explanation)

chapters.title: Determination of National Income
chapters.description: National income accounting aggregates (GDP, GNP, NDP, NNP at MP & FC), measurement methods (Product, Income, Expenditure), and Keynesian determination models (2, 3, 4 sectors, Multipliers).

topics.title: National Income Aggregates & Circular Flow
learningObjectives: Aggregates: GDP_MP, GDP_FC, GNP_MP, GNP_FC, NDP_MP, NDP_FC (Domestic Income), NNP_FC (National Income)
Adjustments: Net Indirect Taxes (NIT = Indirect Taxes - Subsidies), Net Factor Income from Abroad (NFIA = Factor Income from abroad - Factor Income paid abroad), Depreciation
Personal Income, Disposable Personal Income, Real vs Nominal GDP, GDP Deflator

topics.title: Measurement of National Income (Value Added, Income & Expenditure Methods)
learningObjectives: Value Added / Product Method: Gross Value of Output - Intermediate Consumption, Problem of double counting
Income Method: Compensation of Employees (COE) + Operating Surplus (Rent, Interest, Royalty, Profit) + Mixed Income
Expenditure Method: Private Final Consumption Expenditure (C) + Government Final Consumption (G) + Gross Domestic Capital Formation (I) + Net Exports (X - M)
Precautions and treatment of transfer payments, second-hand goods, illegal income

topics.title: Keynesian Theory of National Income Determination & Multipliers
learningObjectives: Consumption function C = a + bY, Marginal Propensity to Consume (MPC = b), Average Propensity to Consume (APC)
Savings function S = -a + (1-b)Y, MPS = (1-b); MPC + MPS = 1, APC + APS = 1
Equilibrium in 2-Sector (Y = C + I, S = I), 3-Sector (Y = C + I + G), and 4-Sector (Y = C + I + G + X - M) economies
Investment Multiplier: K = 1 / (1 - MPC) = 1 / MPS; Foreign trade multiplier
topics.pdfTitle: Unit 2: Keynesian Theory of National Income Determination

chapters.title: Public Finance

learningObjectives: Richard Musgrave's Three Fiscal Functions: Allocation, Distribution, Stabilization

topics.title: Fiscal Policy, Public Debt & Budget Deficits

topics.title: Concept of Money Demand
learningObjectives: Classical Quantity Theory: Fisher's Equation of Exchange (MV = PT)
Cambridge Cash Balance Approach (M = kPY - Marshall, Pigou, Robertson)
Keynesian Liquidity Preference Theory: Transaction Motive, Precautionary Motive, Speculative Motive (Liquidity Trap concept)

topics.title: Money Supply Measures & Money Multiplier

High Powered Money / Reserve Money (M0 = Currency in circulation + Bankers' deposits with RBI + Other deposits with RBI)
Money Multiplier process: m = M3 / M0; Credit creation formula = Primary Deposit * (1 / LRR)

topics.title: Monetary Policy Instruments of RBI
learningObjectives: Monetary Policy Framework and Objectives

Quantitative Instruments: Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR), Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR), Repo Rate, Reverse Repo Rate, Standing Deposit Facility (SDF), Marginal Standing Facility (MSF), Bank Rate, Open Market Operations (OMO)
Qualitative / Selective Instruments: Margin requirements, Moral suasion, Credit rationing

Theory of Absolute Advantage (Adam Smith)
Theory of Comparative Advantage (David Ricardo - Opportunity cost)
Heckscher-Ohlin Modern Theory of Factor Endowments (H-O Theorem) and Leontief Paradox
